newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues up, no comment on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues up, no comment on restructuring.

text.p: French building group Bouygues declined to comment on a report on Friday that it was considering a possible reorganisation of its capital structure on the occasion of the purchase of Cise by its Saur unit.
The newspaper Le Figaro said chairman Martin Bouygues was considering "clarifying the structure of the family shareholding" in tandem with the previously announced purchase of Cise from Saint-Gobain.
Brokers said the report as well as Bouygues Offshore's announcement of a $65 million contract in Russia had helped the share, which was 2.94 percent higher on the Paris bourse.
"We have no comment" on the restructuring report, a Bouygues spokesman said.
